site.name: Blue Prince Toolkit
site.description: Free fan-made tools for Blue Prince: a dartboard calculator, a house planner, room card and letter makers, and more. Spoilers stay hidden until you ask for them.
site.intro: Fan-made helpers, references and generators for the estate. Anything that could spoil a discovery stays hidden until you ask for it.

tools.title: House Planner
tools.blurb: Lay out a day's house on the 5 × 9 grid, with gem costs, room colours and door checks. Export the plan as an image.
tools.description: Plan a day's house in Blue Prince on the 5 × 9 grid: place and turn rooms, add up gems, count room colours and spot doors that can't work. Save or share the plan as an image.
tools.intro: Lay out a day's house on the 5 × 9 grid. Pick a room, place it, and the planner adds up the gems, counts the colours and flags doors that can't work.

tools.title: Room Card Maker
tools.blurb: Design your own room in the style of the estate's floor-plan cards and save it as a picture.
tools.description: Make your own Blue Prince room card: choose the name, colour, doors, gem cost, icon, effect text and floor, then save it as a PNG.
tools.intro: Design your own floor plan in the style of the estate's room cards, then save it as a picture.

tools.title: Letter & Note Maker
tools.blurb: Write a letter, memo, note or notice on the estate's paper and save it as a picture.
tools.description: Write letters, memos, notes and notices in the style of Blue Prince's documents: drawn frames, ornate capitals, handwriting or typewriter text, stamps and worn paper. Save them as PNG.
tools.intro: Write a letter, memo, note or notice on the estate's paper, then save it as a picture.

tools.title: Darts Calculator
tools.blurb: Copy a dartboard and get it written out as an equation, with the working and answer behind a click.
tools.description: A calculator for the dartboard puzzle in Blue Prince. Copy the board and it is written out as an equation; the working and the answer stay hidden until you ask.
tools.intro: Copy the dartboard by colouring its sections, and the calculator writes it out as an equation. The working and the answer stay hidden until you ask.

tools.title: Sigil Maker
tools.blurb: Build a sigil from its parts and export it as an SVG or PNG.
tools.description: Build a sigil for Blue Prince from its parts and export it as an SVG or PNG. The tool's contents stay hidden until you choose to open it.
tools.intro: Build a sigil from its parts and export it as an SVG or PNG.
